mapper.insert: INSERT INTO favorites (member_id, place_id, memo) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{placeId}, #{memo,jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM favorites WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND place_id = #{placeId}
mapper.update: UPDATE favorites SET memo = #{memo,jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR} WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND place_id = #{placeId}
mapper.select: SELECT member_id, place_id, memo, created_at FROM favorites WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, place_id

SELECT p.place_id, p.category_id, p.region_id, p.provider, p.external_id, p.title, p.address, p.detail_address, p.zipcode, p.latitude, p.longitude, p.place_url, p.is_active, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM favorites f INNER JOIN places p ON p.place_id = f.place_id WHERE f.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY f.created_at DESC, f.place_id
